title: Mitigate multi-region routing blip affecting hosted & Dedicated tenants
creator: Anika Patel
description: Summary: On 2026-03-10 01:15 UTC a routing configuration change in the edge traffic manager caused inconsistent region selection for a subset of requests. Impact: hosted API customers saw transient 5-20% error spikes and elevated tail latency; several Dedicated tenants observed requests routed to regions with depleted reserved capacity which triggered rate-limits and degraded throughput. Private deployments were unaffected. Scope: affected regions primarily us-west-2 and eu-west-1; cross-region traffic-shift logic that combines recent capacity signals with per-tenant affinity was the likely source. Immediate mitigation: - Rolled back edge routing config pushed as part of feature rollout (edge-config rollback id: rc-2026-03-10-01). - Applied a hotfix to the traffic decision service to treat negative capacity scores as soft-degrades rather than outright avoidance. - Per-tenant manual rebalancing commands executed for 6 dedicated tenants (see links). Technical root cause hypothesis: a regression in the new 'capacity smoothing' heuristic made temporary underruns overly punitive when combined with the affinity-preservation code path; this produced oscillation where requests were repeatedly steered away from a region that still had usable reserved capacity. Consequences included unnecessary cold-starts for streaming workers and KV cache misses. Short-term fixes implemented: 1) rollback of rollout flags at the edge to stable policy 2) hotfix to traffic-decision microservice (v1.18.3 -> v1.18.4) that clamps capacity deltas 3) triggered KV cache re-warm for affected model shards in us-west-2 4) raised autoscaler lower-bound for dedicated pools temporarily to prevent aggressive scale-down. Planned long-term actions: - Add integration test that simulates rapid capacity fluctuations + affinity retention to catch oscillatory behavior. - Instrument per-tenant routing decisions with traceable decision metadata and add alert when oscillation pattern detected. - Improve canary policy to include dedicated pool saturation tests before enabling smoothing heuristics. - Update failover runbook with explicit manual traffic-shift command sequences for Dedicated tenants and rollback playbook for Hosted edge. Communication: customer support and account teams were notified within 30 minutes of first detection; postmortem draft and customer-facing timeline scheduled. Links to artifacts and PRs are below. Next steps: finalize hotfix cleanup, run full regression test in staging, ship runtime-1.20.1 with test coverage, and schedule postmortem meeting with product and SRE for 2026-03-17.
comments: 2026-03-10 01:22 UTC - Anika Patel: Initial alert from monitoring (traffic-manager error rate up). Spinning up incident channel, paging on-call SRE. Noted correlated spikes in dedicated tenant 472 and hosted route /v1/generate.

2026-03-10 01:35 UTC - Marco Chen: Rolled back edge-config rc-2026-03-10-01 which reduced error rate for hosted routes by ~60% within 3 minutes. Still seeing some dedicated tenant 5xxs related to capacity limits.

2026-03-10 02:05 UTC - Sofia Martinez (SRE): Applied hotfix to traffic-decision service (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/traffic-decision/pull/7892). Observed stabilization in region selection; however, two dedicated pools still reported under-provisioning. Manual rebalances executed: dedicated-pool-03, dedicated-pool-07.
2026-03-10 02:45 UTC - Liam O'Connor (Infra): Triggered KV cache re-warm for model shard q3v2 in us-west-2. Confirmed cache hit-rate recovery from 12% -> 78% after 18 minutes.
2026-03-10 03:10 UTC - Priya Shah (PM): Notified affected customers and provided ETA for full mitigation in private thread. Drafted a short status notice for Customer Success to send within the hour.

2026-03-11 09:00 UTC - Marco Chen: Began root-cause analysis. Found that capacity-smoothing window default reduced weight on immediate recent capacity values below threshold, allowing affinity code to shift traffic based on stale affinity tokens. Creating unit tests to simulate combined policy.
2026-03-12 14:20 UTC - Anika Patel: Post-fix monitoring shows normal baselines; re-opened this ticket to track follow-up actions and runbook updates. Planning postmortem 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC.

2026-03-13 10:15 UTC - Marco Chen: Drafted runbook additions in Confluence and PR for runbook changes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Runbooks+-+Region+Failover. Please review before 2026-03-15.
2026-03-14 08:30 UTC - Sofia Martinez: Added an alert to catch oscillation patterns; alert threshold tuned to fire at 3 region flips within 5 minutes for a single tenant.
